name: Virgo I (Hubble)
blurb: Virgo I, an ultra-faint dwarf galaxy orbiting the Milky Way, seen by Hubble.
label: virgoi-hubble
story: Virgo I is one of the faintest dwarf galaxies known, a sparse scatter of stars circling our Milky Way. Hubble looked deep among those stars to confirm its true nature.

claims.text: Virgo I is an ultra-faint dwarf satellite companion of the Milky Way
Virgo I is one of the faintest dwarf satellites known
Hubble ACS imaging was proposed to confirm Virgo I's nature with a deep color-magnitude diagram
